title: Fix React minified error #185 causing runtime failure

requirements.summary: Investigate and resolve React minified error #185 in the deployed application, which typically indicates a hydration mismatch, invalid DOM nesting, or rendering inconsistency between server and client
acceptanceCriteria: React error #185 no longer appears in browser console after deployment
Application loads and renders without runtime errors
All pages and components display correctly without hydration warnings

file_operations.description: Configure Vite to generate source maps in production builds by adding 'sourcemap: true' to the build configuration. This enables full React error messages and stack traces for debugging error #185 in deployed environments.
Add a 'dev:debug' script that runs the development server with React's non-minified build to reveal the full error message and component stack trace for error #185.

inside

acceptanceCriteria: All component JSX follows valid HTML nesting rules
No nested interactive elements (buttons inside buttons, links inside buttons)
Block-level elements are not nested inside inline elements

file_operations.description: Audit JSX structure for invalid DOM nesting, particularly checking that draggable elements, buttons, and message containers follow valid HTML hierarchy. Ensure no block-level elements are nested inside inline elements, and no interactive elements (buttons/links) are nested within each other.

Review header navigation, authentication buttons, and chat widget integration for invalid DOM nesting. Verify that navigation links are not nested inside buttons, and that the layout structure follows valid HTML element parent-child relationships.

Audit all widget components, card structures, and interactive elements for DOM nesting violations. Check that widget containers, buttons for editing counters, and permission request cards do not contain nested interactive elements or invalid block/inline element combinations.

Review message rendering, message type selection buttons, recipient selection, and social media link displays for invalid DOM nesting. Ensure message cards do not contain nested buttons or links inside clickable containers.

Audit profile update forms, invitation token displays with copy buttons, and account deletion buttons for nested interactive elements. Verify that form buttons and action buttons are not nested within each other or within invalid parent elements.

requirements.summary: Check Dashboard.tsx, Chat.tsx, Settings.tsx, and Layout.tsx for conditional rendering logic that may cause hydration mismatches between initial render and subsequent renders
acceptanceCriteria: Conditional rendering based on authentication state uses consistent logic
No components render different content on client vs server hydration
Loading states are properly managed to prevent render mismatches

file_operations.description: Review role-based conditional rendering for parent and child widgets. Ensure that authentication checks and role checks use consistent logic that produces the same render output on initial load and subsequent renders. Add proper loading states that prevent content flash and hydration mismatches.

Audit authentication-gated access and message type conditional rendering logic. Ensure that conditional renders based on authentication state, message history loading, and AI analysis toggles maintain consistent DOM structure between initial and subsequent renders.

Review conditional rendering for role-based features (parent-only invitation generation), profile data loading states, and account deletion confirmation. Ensure consistent render output regardless of timing of data fetches.

Audit authentication-based navigation visibility, login/logout button state, and chat widget conditional rendering. Ensure that authentication state checks produce consistent DOM structure and do not cause hydration mismatches when identity loads asynchronously.

requirements.summary: Verify all React hooks (useState, useEffect, useQuery) in role-based widget rendering on Dashboard.tsx do not cause rendering conflicts or stale closure issues
acceptanceCriteria: Dashboard role-based widget conditional rendering works without errors
React hooks have correct dependency arrays
No infinite render loops or state update conflicts

file_operations.description: Review all useQuery hooks for user profile, expenses, permissions, and family data. Verify dependency arrays in useEffect hooks are complete and correct. Check that role-based widget conditional rendering does not cause state updates during render or create stale closures.

Audit all React Query hooks for proper enabled conditions, dependency tracking, and refetch logic. Ensure that query keys are stable and do not cause unnecessary re-renders or conflicts when used in Dashboard widget rendering.
Review mutation hooks and form state management for proper dependency arrays and state update patterns. Ensure that expense mutations do not trigger render conflicts when Dashboard queries refetch.

requirements.summary: Review ProfileSetupModal and ChatWidget components for improper portal usage, modal rendering, or floating element positioning that could cause DOM nesting violations
acceptanceCriteria: Modals and floating widgets render in correct DOM hierarchy
No portals create invalid parent-child relationships
Draggable chat widget positioning does not violate DOM constraints

file_operations.description: Review ProfileSetupModal rendering logic, portal usage (if any), and conditional rendering based on authentication and profile fetch state. Ensure modal opens only when both authenticated and profile is confirmed null (not during loading state), preventing hydration mismatches.

Audit draggable floating widget positioning logic and DOM structure. Verify that the widget's absolute positioning and drag handlers do not create invalid DOM parent-child relationships. Check that the widget container is properly placed in the Layout component without nesting violations.

Review dialog/modal component usage for proper portal rendering and DOM hierarchy. If using shadcn/ui Dialog components, verify they render in a portal at document root level and do not cause nesting violations with their trigger buttons.

requirements.summary: Enable non-minified development build or add source maps to get the full React error message and stack trace for debugging error #185
acceptanceCriteria: Full error message and component stack trace are visible
Exact component and line number causing error #185 is identified
Development build successfully reveals root cause

file_operations.description: Add source map configuration to the Vite build settings: set 'build.sourcemap' to true or 'inline' to generate source maps that map minified production code back to original source files. This enables full error messages and precise stack traces for React error #185.
Add a development debugging script such as 'dev:debug' that runs 'vite --mode development' to ensure non-minified React builds with full error messages and component stack traces for local debugging.
Create a development environment file that sets VITE_ENVIRONMENT=development to ensure React runs in development mode locally, providing full error messages instead of minified error codes.

requirements.summary: Test the application end-to-end after fixes to ensure error #185 is completely resolved and no new React errors are introduced
acceptanceCriteria: Application deploys successfully without build errors
All pages load without React runtime errors
Role selection, dashboard widgets, and chat functionality work correctly
Browser console shows no React errors or warnings

file_operations.description: Add error boundary component wrapping the entire application to catch and log any remaining React errors during testing. Verify ProfileSetupModal, router navigation, and invitation token processing work without errors after all fixes are applied.

Test all role-based widget rendering paths (parent vs child dashboards), verify permission requests display correctly, test happiness meter, expense tracking, and fights/problems solved widgets render without errors.

Test group and private messaging, verify message type selection (text, grocery list, social media link) renders correctly, test AI conflict analysis toggle, and ensure recipient selection works without DOM errors.
Test navigation between all pages, verify authentication flow (login/logout), test chat widget opening/closing and dragging, verify onboarding tooltips display correctly without causing React errors.
Test profile updates, verify invitation token generation and display for parents, test account deletion confirmation, ensure all role-based conditional features render correctly without errors.
